title: Foeniculum vulgare tea for medicinal use
intro: Foeniculum vulgare tea is a herbal infusion made from the dried seeds of the fennel plant, which is known for its licorice-like flavor and aromatic properties. It has been traditionally used in herbalism to support digestion, relieve gas, and soothe the gastrointestinal tract. This tea is also valued for its potential to ease menstrual discomfort and promote lactation in nursing mothers. Additionally, it may help with respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis due to its expectorant properties. Fennel tea is often consumed as a calming and digestive aid, making it a popular remedy in both traditional and modern herbal practices.
